    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AboutDialog
    The About dialog of the standard about() command.
    Application
    Declares the application class: its names, as gaia's ApplicationDirectories takes them, and its version.
    ApplicationDescriptor
    The names of an Application class, which the processor generates and registers as a service.
    ApplicationInfo
    What the application is and where it runs, bound in the root injector.
    AppTester<T>
    Runs an application in a test: the real lifecycle, headless, with fakes for the platform, the directories, the clock and the dialogs.
    AppTester.Builder<T>
    The configuration of an application to start.
    Arguments
    The arguments given to the launch of the application, bound in the root injector.
    Binding<T>
    The binding of a component to a property in a Form, with the rules its value must meet.
    Block
    What is blocked while a task runs.
    BoundCommand
    A command of a view, turned into Swing objects.
    BoundMenu
    A menu of a view, with its resources, that descriptions are made from.
    Check
    The status of one requirement of a value.
    Check.Status
    Whether a value meets a requirement.
    Column<E,V>
    A column of a table bound to an observable list with Ui.bind(javax.swing.JTable, be.imgn.swing.ObservableList, java.util.List): its header, the type of its values and how a row gives its value.
    Command
    Declares a command: its handler is the annotated method, a non-private, non-static method returning void or Task<?>, that takes no parameter or a single CommandContext.
    CommandBuilder
    Builds a command of a CommandRegistry; generated code calls it.
    CommandContext
    How a command was activated: the modifier keys held, and the trigger with the objects of its path.
    CommandRegistry
    Every command of a view, keyed by the class the generated class is for (StandardCommands for standard commands) and the id: asking twice for the same command returns the same BoundCommand.
    ComponentInjector<V>
    Writes a view class's resources to the components its fields hold, and to the component fields of those components that its nested tables name, read through the enclosing fields, with plain setter calls.
    ComponentResources
    The resources of a view class, read by field path and property, as the generated injectors write them.
    ComponentState<V>
    Gives the components of a view whose state is saved with its window: its non-private JSplitPane, JTabbedPane and JTable fields.
    Concurrency
    What an activation of a command does while a task the command started still runs.
    Converter<T>
    Converts the text of a field to a value and back, for Form.bind(javax.swing.text.JTextComponent, be.imgn.swing.Property, Converter).
    DarkMode
    Reads whether the operating system uses a dark theme, once: on macOS, defaults read -g AppleInterfaceStyle; on Windows, the AppsUseLightTheme registry value through reg query; on Linux, gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface color-scheme.
    Dialogs
    Shows standard dialogs, owned by its window.
    DialogView<R>
    A view shown in a modal dialog, owned by the window of the view that opened it, with its own content, commands and scope.
    DisplayLocale
    The locale of user-interface text, chosen once at startup and bound in the root injector.
    Document
    The document of a document view, a bean of its scope: its file, its name and whether it is modified.
    DocumentCommands
    The commands of a document view, beside the standard ones: new, open, save and save as, and the recent files.
    DocumentFormat<T>
    How a document's contents are read from and written to a file.
    Documents
    Creates and opens documents: each in a frame of its own, or, for the application class of a single-frame application, in its main frame.
    DocumentView<T>
    A view that edits a file: a frame view, the application class of a single-frame application included.
    DynamicEntry
    An entry of a dynamic section of a menu: a command, a separator, a submenu or a plain item.
    DynamicEntry.Item
    A plain item of a dynamic section.
    EdtExecutor
    The executor of OnEdt: runs each task with EventQueue.invokeLater(Runnable).
    EventExecutor
    The executor of a subscribing annotation on the application's event bus, contributed with @IntoSet(EventExecutor.class).
    Exit
    Ends the JVM at the end of the shutdown.
    ExitVeto
    Asked before the application exits, on the UiExecutor's thread.
    Exposed
    Marks a field that generated code reads, which is therefore not private: a component field, for its resources and its window state, or a field that Command.enabled() or Command.selected() names.
    FailureHandler
    Handles a failure nothing else handles, such as a task's with no onFailure handler.
    FakeDialogs
    The tester's Dialogs: records the dialogs shown and answers them.
    FakeNotifications
    The tester's Notifications: supported, it records each notification.
    FakeNotifications.Notification
    A notification shown.
    FakeShell
    The tester's SystemShell: it supports both actions, and records the URIs browsed and the files opened.
    FakeTaskbar
    The tester's TaskbarStatus: it records the current state, and checks its arguments as the real one does.
    FileChoice
    A file chooser the application showed, as FakeDialogs.fileChoices() records it.
    FileChoice.Kind
    Whether a chooser opens or saves a file.
    FileType
    A type of file a chooser offers as a filter, such as text files.
    FlatLafInstaller
    Installs FlatLaf, light or dark: the be.imgn.swing.theme system property, else the theme key of the application's resources, selects system (the default), light or dark.
    Form
    Binds the input components of a view to properties, validates their values, and tracks whether they changed.
    FormPanel
    Lays out a form in two columns, with GridBagLayout, in the order its methods are called: rows of a label and its field, wide components across both columns, and section titles.
    Frames
    Opens frame views in frames of their own, and tracks them.
    FrameView
    A view shown in a frame of its own, with the frame's menu bar and toolbar: the application class of a single-frame application, or a view that Frames opens.
    IconLoader
    Loads icons of one kind, contributed with @IntoSet(IconLoader.class).
    Lifecycle
    Requests the shutdown of the application.
    ListChange<E>
    A change of an ObservableList, with indices valid for the list just before it.
    ListChange.Added<E>
    Elements added at an index.
    ListChange.Removed<E>
    Elements removed from an index.
    ListChange.Replaced<E>
    Elements replaced from an index by others, not necessarily as many.
    LookAndFeelInstaller
    Installs the look and feel, on the EDT, before any component is created.
    MenuEntry
    An entry of a menu description: a command, a separator, a submenu or a dynamic section.
    MenuEntry.Dynamic
    A section of a menu whose entries come from an observable.
    MenuSpec
    An immutable description of a menu: its menu and its entries.
    MessagePattern
    The pattern of one message, with its placeholders rewritten from parameter names to indices, formatted with MessageFormat for the display locale.
    Messages
    Declares an interface of typed messages.
    Modifier
    A modifier key held when a command was activated.
    MultiFrame
    An application class that opens frames from code, each showing a FrameView of its own, such as a document per frame.
    Notifications
    Shows system notifications.
    Observable<T>
    A value that tells its listeners when it changes.
    ObservableList<E>
    A list that tells its listeners each change, so that a component showing it updates one row rather than all of them.
    OnEdt
    Subscribes a method to the events of its parameter's type, delivered on the EDT, in the order they were published.
    OpenDialog<V>
    A dialog view the tester shows, as an answer registered with FakeDialogs.answerDialog(Class, Consumer) sees it.
    OpenFilesHandler
    Opens the files the operating system hands to the application, such as those the user opens from the macOS Finder or drops on the Dock icon.
    OpenFrame<V>
    A frame the application opened, as the tester sees it: the main frame of a single-frame application, or a frame that Frames opened.
    PreferencesHandler
    Shows the application's preferences: a singleton bean of the application.
    Property<T>
    An observable value that can be set, from any thread.
    PublishingWork<T,P>
    The work of a Task that publishes partial results while it runs: Task.of(PublishingWork, Consumer).
    ReadyListener
    Told when the application is ready: once the main window is shown, and the events posted while showing it have run.
    RecentFiles
    The files the user opened or saved last, most recent first, at most ten.
    ResourceOpener
    Opens the resources of one package, from the package's own module, so that reading them needs no open package.
    Resources
    The resources of classes: their TOML files, merged along the class hierarchy and across the locale and platform variants, and cached per class and locale.
    Rule<T>
    A requirement of a value, and the test of whether a value meets it.
    SaveChoice
    The answer to the save prompt, Dialogs.askSave(String).
    Scope
    The disposal list of an application, window or view scope, for what is not a bean.
    SecondInstanceHandler
    Handles a second launch of a single-instance application.
    Separator
    The separator of menus and toolbars, which MenuEntry.SEPARATOR, DynamicEntry.SEPARATOR and ToolBarEntry.SEPARATOR name.
    Settings
    Declares a settings record: what the user chooses and keeps between runs, saved in <id>.toml in the application's config directory.
    SettingsDescriptor<T>
    The description of a Settings record, which the processor generates and registers as a service.
    SettingsStore
    Holds the value of every Settings record, loaded at startup from the config directory.
    ShutdownStep
    A step of the shutdown, contributed with @IntoSet(ShutdownStep.class).
    SingleFrame
    An application class that is the only view of the main window.
    StandardCommands
    The standard commands of a view, with working handlers, and the superclass of every generated <Class>Commands.
    StandardMenus
    The standard menus of a view, with text and mnemonics from the framework's resources, and the superclass of every generated <Class>Menus.
    StartupStep
    A step of the startup, contributed with @IntoSet(StartupStep.class).
    Subscription
    A listener's subscription to an Observable, released when its scope closes or when it is closed.
    SvgIconLoader
    Loads SVG icons, through FlatSVGIcon: they stay sharp on HiDPI screens.
    Swing
    Launches applications.
    SystemAction
    An action of the operating system's application menu.
    SystemShell
    Asks the system to show a URI in the browser, or a file in the application that the system associates with it, through java.awt.Desktop.
    Task<T>
    Work that runs on a virtual thread, with its completion hooks.
    TaskbarStatus
    The application's entry in the taskbar, or its Dock icon: a progress, a badge, and requests for the user's attention.
    TaskContext
    What the work of a Task can tell and ask while it runs: Task.of((TaskContext context) -> ...).
    TaskService
    Runs tasks in a scope, without blocking any input.
    TaskWork<T>
    The work of a Task that uses its TaskContext.
    Theme
    The theme of FlatLaf, which the be.imgn.swing.theme system property selects, else the theme key of the application's resources.
    ToolBarEntry
    An entry of a toolbar: a command or a separator.
    Trigger
    The path that activated a command, with the objects that path always has.
    Trigger.ButtonClick
    A button was clicked.
    Trigger.MenuSelection
    A menu item of the menu bar, or of a menu built with MenuSpec.createMenu(), was selected.
    Trigger.OperatingSystem
    The operating system's application menu ran the command.
    Trigger.PopupMenuSelection
    A menu item of a popup menu was selected.
    Trigger.Programmatic
    Code ran the command, as with BoundCommand.execute().
    Trigger.Shortcut
    A shortcut was typed.
    Ui
    What a view needs to build its components.
    UiExecutor
    Runs work on the user-interface thread.
    UndoStack
    The undo stack of a view, a bean of its scope, which the standard undo() and redo() commands act on.
    Validation
    The status of every requirement of a value, met or not, so that a view can show each one and not only the first error.
    ValidationFeedback
    Shows the error of a Form's binding on its component, on the EDT.
    Validator<T>
    The rules of a value, declared once and tested in a form, a command-line tool or a service.
    Variants
    Marks the enum, nested in a dialog view, whose constants name the variants of that dialog: dialogs of one class that differ only by their resources, opened with Ui.showDialog(Class, Enum).
    View
    A component, with its commands and its scope.
    ViewScoped
    Scopes a bean to its view: one instance per view, cached in the view's child injector.
    Window
    A window, as the framework sees it: a frame or a dialog, or a bare root pane in the test harness.
    Windows
    Creates the windows.
    WindowScoped
    Scopes a bean to its window: one instance per window, cached in the window's child injector.
